description: Commentary published by The Bridge Feb. 21, 2024 - Today in Vermont, the top 1% of income earners — Vermonters who make over half a million dollars a year — pay a lower share of their income in state and local taxes than a Vermont family making about $80,000 a year.
title: Commentary by Jared: A Fairer Tax System Can Make Vermont More Affordable For All — Jared for House 2026
